title: Negating Negatives: Alignment with Human Negative Samples via Distributional Dispreference Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment (harmlessness) to ensure models follow human values. It specifically utilizes a comprehensive set of 'moral instructions' (Table 9) for data sampling and evaluates the model's ability to reject unethical, harmful, or inappropriate requests, which are core elements of evaluating ethical reasoning and moral values in Large Language Models.
